title: Aparna CyberZed — Project Brochure
description: Share when a lead asks for project details, floor plans, pricing breakdown, or location map for CyberZed at Osman Nagar. Best used at consideration or portfolio_match stage when lead has shown interest in 3 BHK near Financial District.

title: Aparna Moonstone — Luxury Project Brochure
description: Share when lead asks for details on ultra-luxury 3 or 4 BHK homes in Gachibowli or Gopanpally area. Shows full amenities, floor plans, and location advantages. Use at portfolio_match or consideration stage for high-budget leads.

title: Aparna Newlands — Project Brochure
description: Share when lead is interested in 2.5 or 3 BHK apartments at Tellapur. Highlights the 72,865 sq ft clubhouse and 10 sports courts. Best for families or buyers prioritising amenities and lifestyle.

title: Aparna Synergy — Project Brochure
description: Share when lead is looking for value-for-money 2, 2.5, or 3 BHK in north Hyderabad. Best for first-time buyers, investors, or budget-conscious leads. Highlights child-centric amenities and 28-acre scale.

title: Aparna Constructions — Company Overview Video
description: Share at discovery or qualification stage when a lead asks who Aparna is or wants to know more about the developer. 30 years track record, 61 projects, 30,000 families. Builds trust before the site visit.

title: Aparna — Construction-Linked Payment Plan Guide
description: Share when a lead asks about payment schedules, home loan eligibility, or how payments are structured. Explains construction-linked plan, 20:80 plan, and bank tie-ups. Use at consideration or booking stage.
